title: The Capacity Is Local. The Shock Is Regional.
method: AI-assisted cross-source synthesis with direct links to originating publishers. Reviewed against a six-item gate including two primary institutional sources.

items.source: Kenya National Commission on Human Rights
items.headline: Moyale displacement overwhelms local reception capacity
items.whyItMatters: The rapid rise turns a local conflict into a cross-border capacity test for reception, registration and public health. The total is still a reported estimate, and calm observed on October 27 does not establish that the underlying conflict is resolved.

items.headline: EAC advances regional e-commerce coordination
items.whyItMatters: Common rules and interoperable systems could widen market access for smaller firms and make cross-border trade more usable. The record establishes coordination and planned measures, not completed interoperability or measured commercial outcomes.

items.headline: Kenya reports a second Ebola death and nine confirmed cases
items.whyItMatters: Containment depends on contact tracing holding beyond known exposure chains. The absence of reported community transmission is a current surveillance finding, not proof that onward transmission cannot occur.

items.headline: Ethiopia installs a six-month caretaker administration in Tigray
items.whyItMatters: A fixed mandate creates a near-term test of authority, service restoration and electoral preparation. The administration’s durability and the response of Tigrayan political and armed actors remain unresolved.

items.headline: Abyei market strike exposes a fuel corridor serving Sudan’s war
items.whyItMatters: The record shows how civilian trade routes can become part of a wider war economy and therefore a target. The supply-network evidence does not itself identify who launched the strike.

items.headline: Drought compounds Sudan’s famine risk
items.whyItMatters: Conflict, agricultural loss and reduced assistance are converging instead of arriving as separate shocks. The WFP figures are forecasts, and the food-security totals are being updated.
